name_zh: 齐齐哈尔市扎龙生态旅游区
address_zh: 黑龙江省齐齐哈尔市铁锋区扎龙镇扎龙村
address_en: Zhalong Village, Zhalong Town, Tiefeng District, Qiqihar City, Heilongjiang Province
intro_zh: 扎龙生态旅游区位于齐齐哈尔市铁锋区，总面积4.7平方公里。扎龙生态旅游区湿地风光秀美，拥有扎龙湖、荷仙池鹤唳云天、鹿鹤同春、芦林鹤影等游览景区，打造了望鹤楼、水禽岛、名鹤苑、扎龙湿地博物馆、丹顶鹤野化训飞区等丰富多样的旅游景点。
intro_en: Zhalong Ecological Tourism Zone is located in Tiefeng District, Qiqihar City, with a total area of ​​4.7 square kilometers. The Zhalong Ecological Tourism Zone has beautiful wetland scenery, including Zhalong Lake, Hexian Pond, Cranes in the Sky, Deer and Cranes in Spring, and Crane Shadows in Lulin. It has created a variety of tourist attractions such as Wanghe Tower, Waterfowl Island, Minghe Garden, Zhalong Wetland Museum, and Red-crowned Crane Rewilding and Flying Area.
